definitions.explanation: Used to describe attractive, well-formed handwriting, and also as a category for handwriting improvement courses and books.

examples.japanese: {美文字|びもじ}を{書|か}けるようになりたい。
examples.english: I want to be able to write beautiful handwriting.

examples.japanese: {美文字|びもじ}レッスンに{通|かよ}い{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I started attending beautiful handwriting lessons.

examples.japanese: {美文字|びもじ}の{練習|れんしゅう}には{正|ただ}しい{姿勢|しせい}と{筆|ふで}の{持|も}ち{方|かた}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: For practicing beautiful handwriting, proper posture and pen grip are important.

notes:
Combines {美|び} (beauty) and {文字|もじ} (characters/writing). A popular term in Japanese culture where handwriting quality is highly valued. There is a thriving industry of {美文字|びもじ} books, courses, and TV segments teaching how to write more elegantly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美文字|びもじ}レッスン: beautiful handwriting lessons
- {美文字|びもじ}{練習帳|れんしゅうちょう}: penmanship practice workbook
- {美文字|びもじ}のコツ: tips for beautiful handwriting
- {美文字|びもじ}{講座|こうざ}: beautiful handwriting course

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {達筆|たっぴつ}: excellent calligraphy/penmanship — more traditional, implies mastery
- {悪筆|あくひつ}: bad handwriting — the opposite
- {癖字|くせじ}: idiosyncratic handwriting — not necessarily bad, but distinctive
